sessions.phase_label: Thumbnail scoping, design production, and project closure

requirements.title: First Video YouTube Thumbnail
requirements.definition: Create a finished YouTube thumbnail for the nonprofit's first video using the supplied video, design brief, preferences, and references.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the requested thumbnail artifact and its overall conformity to the supplied brief. Subject-image sourcing and AI-assisted editing are separate because each received an independent client decision. Delivery deadlines, payment, concept counts volunteered by the freelancer, and the unrequested silhouette variation are excluded.

requirements.title: Thumbnail Subject Image Source
requirements.definition: Use frame grabs from the current video recording as the source for the client's image in the current thumbnail rather than requiring separately photographed headshots.
requirements.boundary_note: The source-image choice can be changed and evaluated independently from the overall thumbnail design. The discussion of taking headshots for future videos does not establish a current-project Requirement.

requirements.title: Thumbnail AI Editing Policy
requirements.definition: Constrain thumbnail production to manually created or photographed assets, prohibit AI generation of complete assets and wholesale AI alteration of photographs, and permit only limited Photoshop Generative Fill touch-ups.
requirements.boundary_note: The prohibited generation methods and narrow touch-up exception form one tightly coupled production policy. They are kept separate from the thumbnail artifact because the permitted workflow was independently negotiated and revised.

unresolved_candidates.description: The linked Google document may contain additional concrete design constraints, but its contents are not present in the supplied project history and cannot be safely instantiated as Requirements.

Three video titles are supplied for planned A/B testing, but the messages do not clearly establish an independent deliverable to create title variants, implement the A/B test, or produce separate thumbnail treatments for each title.
